cases.question: Is 2.5% guaranteed every single year?

response.message:
The 2.5% figure is not a guaranteed interest rate credited to the Account Value every single year from the start of the policy [1].

The brochure states that the Account Value is guaranteed to have accumulated to at least an amount as if the interest rate credited had been 2.5% per annum, but this guarantee is only applicable to a policy that has been in force for 15 years or more [1].

This means the 2.5% guarantee is a long-term floor that applies after the policy has been active for at least 15 years, not a fixed annual rate credited to the account for every year of the policy's life [1].

The current assumed base crediting interest rate of 4.0% and the retrospective additional interest rate of 0.25% are explicitly stated to be non-guaranteed and subject to change [2][1].

Therefore, the 2.5% is a conditional, long-term accumulation guarantee, not a guaranteed annual crediting rate for every single year of the policy term [1].

cases.question: What are the cooling-off rights?

response.message:
You may return the policy within 21 calendar days after the delivery of the Policy or the delivery of the Notice stating the policy is available for collection, whichever is earlier [1].
To exercise this right, you must return the policy under a signed covering letter to the insurer's designated address in Hong Kong or Macau [1].
The insurer will cancel the policy upon receipt of your written request and refund all premiums and the applicable levy (for Hong Kong) without any interest [1].
No refund will be made if a benefit payment has already been made, is to be made, or is impending [1].
